text: In the beginner's mind there are many possibilities, but in the expert's mind there are few.
attribution: Shunryu Suzuki, Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind

text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Water is fluid, soft, and yielding. But water will wear away rock, which is rigid and cannot yield.
The snow goose need not bathe to make itself white. Neither need you do anything but be yourself.
Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom. Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.
Quiet the mind, and the soul will speak.
Yoga is the cessation of the movements of the mind.
The present moment is the only moment available to us, and it is the door to all moments.
Nothing in the world is as soft and yielding as water. Yet for dissolving the hard and inflexible, nothing can surpass it.
The heart that breaks open can contain the whole universe.
In autumn, the leaves know how to let go.
May all beings be happy; may all beings be peaceful; may all beings be free.
The ground of practice is you, just as you are.

When we honestly ask ourselves which person in our lives means the most to us, we often find that it is those who, instead of giving advice, solutions, or cures, have chosen to share our pain and touch our wounds with a warm and tender hand.
Yin asks us to stop making things happen and allow things to unfold.
If you want to awaken all of humanity, awaken all of yourself. If you want to eliminate the suffering in the world, eliminate all that is dark and negative in yourself.
Between stimulus and response, there is a space. In that space is our power to choose our response.
attribution: Viktor Frankl (widely attributed; source: Man's Search for Meaning)

text: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Surrender to what is. Let go of what was. Have faith in what will be.
The root of suffering is attachment.
To the mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders.
attribution: Laozi, Tao Te Ching (interpretive translation, various translators)

text: I took a deep breath and listened to the old brag of my heart: I am, I am, I am.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
Only when we are brave enough to explore the darkness will we discover the infinite power of our light.
In all things of nature there is something of the marvelous.
